title: phi-code routing configuration
description: Maps task categories to models and agents. The runtime file lives at ~/.phi/agent/routing.json (written by /phi-init or /plan-models); this schema documents its shape.

routes.description: One route per task category (code, debug, explore, plan, test, review)

keywords.description: Keywords that classify a prompt into this category

fallback.description: Model used when the preferred one is unavailable or times out

agent.description: Agent definition (agents/<name>.md) applied for this category
